headword: {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}
gloss: winning streak record; consecutive win record

definitions.gloss: winning streak record; consecutive win record
definitions.explanation: A record of consecutive victories in sports, games, or competitions. Refers both to an ongoing streak and to the historical record for most consecutive wins.

examples.japanese: {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}が{止|と}まった。
{連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}を{更新|こうしん}し{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: They continue to extend the winning streak record.

examples.japanese: この{力士|りきし}は{大相撲|おおずもう}の{連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}に{並|なら}ぶ{勢|いきお}いだ。
examples.english: This wrestler is on pace to match the consecutive win record in professional sumo.

notes:
A compound of {連勝|れんしょう} (consecutive victories, winning streak) and {記録|きろく} (record). This is a common term in sports journalism and everyday sports conversation.

In Japanese sports culture, {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく} is a closely watched statistic, particularly in baseball, sumo, and competitive board games like shogi and go. Famous winning streaks become part of sports lore.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}を{更新|こうしん}する: to set a new winning streak record
- {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}が{止|と}まる: for the winning streak to end
- {連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}に{並|なら}ぶ: to tie the winning streak record
- {歴代|れきだい}{連勝記録|れんしょうきろく}: all-time winning streak record

RELATED WORDS:
- {連勝|れんしょう}: winning streak, consecutive wins
- {連敗|れんぱい}: losing streak, consecutive losses
- {連敗記録|れんぱいきろく}: consecutive loss record
- {新記録|しんきろく}: new record
